'''Chask Fragan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy's]] [[23rd Combat Starfighter Wing]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], he [[Death/Legends|perished]] alongside his [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Kort Habel]] when their ship was cut in half by a gravity slice during the [[Battle of Mindor]].
